decisions.decision: CLI calls spu94_reset(state) immediately after spu94_init(...)
decisions.rationale: spu94_init's documented contract does not zero the caller-owned work_buf (D-14); only spu94_reset does. Without the explicit reset, reverb delay lines started with heap residue that surfaced as an audible noise blast once ADR-Phase-6-G plumbed reverb output to the audio path. The reset adds one line, honors the existing library contract, and is forward-compatible with any future consumer.

psx-spx spec says 'multiplication results are divided by 0x8000'. Every other reverb multiply in the codebase already used Q15. The input_scale stage was the only one doing a raw int16×int16 widening multiply. With the universal preset default vLIN=vRIN=0x8000 (Q15 -1.0), raw multiply pinned Lin/Rin to ±INT16_MIN, destroying linearity. Q15 fix restored 24 dB of input range tracking.
